english.toefl: 103–104 legacy departmental minimum; central full-status new scale 5
english.note: Limited-status minima; full status IELTS 7.5 or DET 135. Below full status requires English placement and possible ESL/reduced load. Tests valid two years before entry. No Essentials, MyBest or IELTS One Skill Retake. Exemptions require a US/approved-country degree or at least two years of study/work there, each within five years of entry; foreign English medium alone does not qualify. TA speaking rules separate; DET cannot establish TA proficiency. Department requires IELTS 7.5 or legacy TOEFL 103–104; no departmental DET acceptance established. Confirm current test choice.

applicationFee.note: Current central fee $90 for all applications, overriding older department domestic $70. Waivers limited to eligible domestic categories; international exception only valid exchange agreement with approved fee waiver.

documents: Transcripts showing coursework and awarded degrees
Statement, 500–750 words: interests, career goals, teaching/research experience, achievements and program motivation
At least three references from instructors/research supervisors
requirements.note: Bachelor’s or foreign equivalent; GPA 3.0 last two bachelor years, prior graduate work, biology and science/math graduate coursework. Fall only. Proposed application program Biology: Ecology, Ethology and Evolution (10KS 0315PHD). Faculty contact encouraged. GRE encouraged, not required.

funding.note: Candidates offered admission also receive assistantship/fellowship and tuition-waiver support; financial need not a factor. No current stipend/duration stated.
